### Selected Projects
*Full write-ups: [mcooperjay.github.io/projects](https://mcooperjay.github.io/projects/index.html)*

**NYC Rodent-Activity Risk Mapping** — Built a conditional autoregressive (CAR) model to map rodent activity across NYC city council districts, separating true infestation from reporting bias in 311 data; won the 2026 BYU Statistics Case Study Competition ([write-up](https://mcooperjay.github.io/projects/nyc-rodent-risk.html))

**NHL Trade Analysis Tool** — Built a multiple linear regression (cross-validated across 1,000 splits) on 25 years of NHL data to model on-ice performance, then developed a Streamlit app identifying undervalued players and potential trade targets

**NBA Career Longevity (Bayesian)** — Used a Poisson-Gamma Bayesian model on NBA career records to test whether "blue-blood" college programs predict longer NBA careers, quantifying the effect through posterior credible intervals

**ICU Treatment Effects** — Applied causal inference (propensity score matching) to correct a confounded comparison, reversing its conclusion on patient survival

**Wildfire Severity Forecasting** — Used functional data analysis, applying a historical functional linear model to 30 years of national wildfire data, outperforming an unrestricted baseline

**Heat-Illness Risk Mapping (Houston, TX)** — Applied spatial epidemiology methods, building a CAR model of heat-illness risk from census-tract data; delivered a public risk map and prevention poster

**Company Growth Forecasting** — Compared time series models (ARIMA, Prophet, regression-based) for quarterly growth forecasting, evaluated by out-of-sample RMSE
